fullDescription.intro: Place this node after the initial population has been evaluated. The first pass emits the connected initial population and archive. If no initial archive is connected, the node creates an empty archive with the population schema. Later passes emit both feedback tables retained by Optimization Loop End.

ports.inPort: Initial DE archive. It must use exactly the population schema.
ports.outPort: Population for the current optimization pass.
External DE archive for donor selection during the current pass.
